name: vrdex-restream-1080p60-fargate-benchmark
acceptance: sustained real-time encode with operational CPU headroom
stable bitrate below provider cap during high-motion input
no segment gaps or stalled output
audio stream present for the full run
source-to-slate-to-source switching reflected in watchable output

fallbackDecision.fargatePassesWhen: CPU-only Fargate sustains the target with cost and reliability headroom.
fallbackDecision.gpuFallbackWhen: Fargate misses real-time encode, transition quality, bitrate stability, or cost headroom.
